label.zh: 项目完成后的五种次元（10/10/10/10/5）
label.en: Five dimensions after the portal project (10/10/10/10/5)

note.zh: 权重见 common/special_projects/00_projects_3.txt:811-851；负质量（9800）在AI、特定起源或母星为人造/城市等类型时权重为0，并且每局只出现一次（b_world_intrudes）。
note.en: Weights per common/special_projects/00_projects_3.txt:811-851; Negative Mass (9800) is zeroed for AI empires, some origins and artificial/city-type home planets, and only once per game (b_world_intrudes).

note.zh: 3600–4500天后随机其一；3050在禁止破坏性玩法时权重为0。
note.en: One of them fires after 3600-4500 days; 3050 is zeroed when disruptive gameplay is blocked.

notes.zh: 殖民地2年（权重8/958）或3年（5/739）时的随机事件，也可由荒原飞地（enclave.5170）触发；限非AI、非首都、非母星的原殖民地，每国一次（dportal_country）。选项只是启用“探测位面传送门”特殊项目并添加研究区矿藏。
notes.en: Random colony event at 2 years (weight 8/958) or 3 years (5/739), also fired by enclave.5170; only for non-AI owners, non-capital non-homeworld original colonies, once per country (dportal_country). Its only option enables the portal special project and adds a research-zone deposit.

notes.zh: 选项由帝国决定：科学（非唯灵）、祈祷/灵能祈祷（唯灵）、投石（非唯灵且封建）、骑士（有毒骑士起源）、保留传送门（总是可选）。
notes.en: Options depend on the empire: science (non-spiritualist), prayer / psionic prayer (spiritualist), rocks (non-spiritualist feudal realm), knights (Toxic Knights origin), and always 'keep the portal'.

notes.zh: 镜面次元：一段线性的对话（3020→3024），在3021可选“只做贸易”提前结束；两条路都会设置贸易标记，其后续是故事 event-colony-3029。
notes.en: Mirror dimension: a linear conversation (3020 to 3024); at 3021 'just trade' ends it early. Both paths set the trade flag whose continuation is the story event-colony-3029.

notes.zh: 太虚：1825–3650天后再次触发窥探虚空（3040），启动 NULLVOID_PROJECT，完成后得到3041。
notes.en: Null void: after 1825-3650 days 3040 offers the NULLVOID_PROJECT; its completion shows 3041.

scope.en: The whole portal chain: 3005, the projects, 3006-3012, 3020-3024, 3040/3041, 3050/3055/3060, 9800-9815 and the Negative Mass chain card; continuations link out to event-colony-3029, -3051 and -9820.

uncertain: Details of NULLVOID_PROJECT on_success and 3050/3055/3060 contents were read only for structure, not every reward.
